test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

R is not the mother of P. P is the daughter of S, and S has three daughters.

**Conclusions:**

I. P is the sister of R

II. S is the mother of P.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
Information given can be represented as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ddecb6f16b59beafa6776653e867eaf8f8d18ea2f01d750593284044cee8b8.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a23b1b96d6be100d0ab7df27afdd34540419e63025c8b64d84f2ea519e95bae5.png] 
 
• No direct relation of R with either P or S is given.

 

Conclusions:

I. P is the sister of R → Does not follow (it is possible but not definite).

II. S is the mother of P.→ Does not follow (it is possible but not definite). S can either be mother or father of P.

Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
